GPU/CPU timing numbers are machine-specific and are not reproduced here.
The source checkout has 1 uncommitted/untracked entries; they are NOT in the clone, so a failure of required_files_present or a test import usually means 'commit it first'.
torch (CUDA) was not installed (no --with-gpu): CUDA tests and the GPU spike are not covered.
--montage-subset hashed the ORIGINAL data dir read-only; it checks listed binaries and the named instances only, and does not re-download inputs.
